method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: The puck stem floats above the body with a loose sphere, the near right laptop lid runs through the right arm, blades hover above their motors.
notes.fix: Seat the stem, delete the sphere, move the laptop clear, parent the blades to their hubs.

notes.problem: The drone reads as loose parts, the mast floats, an arm passes through the right laptop screen, the table ends against the wall with no contact.
notes.fix: Parent the arms and mast to the body, slide the right laptop outward, crop the table's far end.

notes.problem: The drone reads exploded, a laptop lid crosses an arm, a wall seam behind the table.
notes.fix: Attach the arms and seat the mast, move the laptop back, one continuous wall.

notes.problem: The top 40 percent is flat empty magenta.
notes.fix: Raise and dolly in so the tray climbs into the upper right.

notes.problem: Empty flat magenta top third, no visible floor plane, outline shadow lines under the tray.
notes.fix: Tilt down and dolly in, a lit floor gradient with a soft contact shadow, delete the edge line shadows.

notes.problem: Isometric tray on a flat magenta field with an empty upper band and no floor contact.
notes.fix: Camera down and in, a lit surface with a contact shadow, the headline into the freed upper left.

notes.problem: A wash seam at about y 400 behind 54 were lied to.
notes.fix: Feather the wash into the terrain with no edge.

notes.problem: A bright sliver on the recess's right wall and streak grain on the board.
notes.fix: Darken the right inner wall and use fine isotropic grain.

notes.problem: Scanline texture on the tabletop, spoofed pill orange against red glyphs.
notes.fix: A clean matte table and the pill in the glyphs' red.

notes.problem: Speckled canopies and a flat magenta lid interior.
notes.fix: S1's canopy material and a darker textured foam.

notes.problem: Speckled canopies and an undecoded case and cartridge.
notes.fix: S1's canopy material, cut the case so the drone stands alone.

notes.problem: Dead pink lower third and a flat field.
notes.fix: Lower the camera so the rack sits lower and larger with a lit floor below.
Lower the camera and scale the rack up about 25 percent.

notes.problem: Coarse grain across the upper sky behind the type.
notes.fix: Half strength and kept off the type wash.

notes.problem: The which way pill sits 52 px from the edge.
